evidence.text: Synthetic merchant specification: One lamp included. USB-C cable and power adapter are not included. Input power 5V. No battery. No waterproof certification.

evidence.label: Evaluation feedback · synthetic
evidence.text: Does the lamp come with a cable?

evidence.label: Conflicting merchant specification · synthetic
evidence.text: Merchant-confirmed synthetic specification: The USB-C cable IS included in every lamp package.

issues.title: Conflicting merchant specifications regarding USB-C cable inclusion
issues.explanation: Two merchant specification records directly contradict each other regarding whether the USB-C cable is included in the package. One specification states the USB-C cable is not included, while another confirmed specification states the USB-C cable is included in every package.
issues.question: Is the USB-C cable included with the desk lamp package or sold separately?
